kind: negative controls across the whole slice

controls.invalid: a caller-supplied dshSessionId treated as binding authority
controls.exactReason: a declaration is evidence of a request, not of an established binding

controls.invalid: a supplied identity that contradicts the source header
controls.outcome: CONFLICT, and readEvents is never reached
controls.exactReason: the source's header named a different session

controls.invalid: more than one candidate satisfying one attempt
controls.outcome: AMBIGUOUS — never resolved by picking one

controls.invalid: an identified session with no readable source
controls.exactReason: a missing read capability is not an empty history

controls.invalid: a missing session treated as an empty event stream
controls.exactReason: the DSH reader reports the absence rather than returning zero events

controls.invalid: a corrupt stored session treated as an empty history

controls.exactReason: the installed reader does not support the stored format

controls.invalid: a sequence gap paginated over silently
controls.outcome: EVENT_GAP with the offending index named
controls.exactReason: DSH logs are documented contiguous from 0

controls.invalid: A's Preview containing B's process events
controls.outcome: each Preview's host/attempt identity matches only its own attempt; the projection roots differ
controls.exactReason: the correlation is built per job at the host boundary that holds both facts

controls.invalid: B's SessionId supplied as A's claimed binding
controls.exactReason: no canonical binding producer exists, so a caller's claim cannot establish one

controls.invalid: the same display label on two different Attempts
controls.outcome: distinct canonical ids and view ids; neither view claims the other's attempt
controls.exactReason: identity is the canonical Work id, not the label
each attempt has its own canonical lifecycle

controls.invalid: interleaved wall-clock timing converted into causal precedence
controls.outcome: no precedence is derived; the two Previews share no edge
controls.exactReason: V0 derives no ordering from timing

controls.invalid: a caller-supplied trustedIngestion flag treated as evidence
controls.outcome: the self-declared claim does not raise the binding above BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY and does not change the canonical promotion state
controls.exactReason: the binding is classified from evidence, not from a record's self-description

controls.invalid: a reader's proves-list propagated into canonical facts
controls.outcome: the page's own proves-list never reaches the Preview's canonical block
controls.exactReason: canonical facts come only from the Work owner

controls.invalid: an unverified T0 cross-owner relation presented as an actionable fact
controls.outcome: quarantined as UNVERIFIED_RELATION and excluded from the selected set
controls.exactReason: T0's ground matching and ProjectIR digest comparison are known incomplete

controls.invalid: building the Preview mutating owner state or the DSH source
controls.outcome: work event count, chain digest, ProjectIR revision/digest, proof basis and reasoning bases all unchanged; the owner's verifyFull still passes; the DSH artifact's sha256 is unchanged
controls.exactReason: no port exposes a write and the module holds no owner
